articles.title: Bitcoin’s BIP-110 fork is 300 blocks behind BTC and six years from fixing itself
articles.snippet: The breakaway chain has produced two blocks since splitting off on Saturday. Bitcoin has produced more than 300 in the same stretch.

articles.title: Bitcoin's 'strongest hands' are back, on-chain data show
articles.snippet: Elite wallets holding over 10,000 BTC has hit a six-month high of 90, building on earlier accumulation by mid-sized whales amid Coldcard fallout and Clarity Act delays.

articles.title: Luke Dashjr Removed as BIP Editor After BIP-110 Bitcoin Fork Stalls
articles.snippet: Supporters of the soft fork he championed split onto their own chain on Saturday, where it mined two blocks in eight hours and stopped.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Draw $854M Over Five Days as Rate-Hike Bets Fade
articles.snippet: Daily totals shrank as the week wore on, and analysts are split on whether the return of institutional money marks a genuine turn.

articles.title: Bitcoin Red Team Says AI Is Finding Critical Exploits Across Core Projects
articles.snippet: A volunteer security effort says it has scanned 150 Bitcoin repositories, disclosed more than a dozen vulnerabilities, and is building an open-source AI platform to automate software security reviews.
